listings.name: Christmas Bow

listings.description:
Stitch a classic Christmas bow with this beginner-friendly hand embroidery pattern — a clean, modern line design of a looped ribbon bow with long trailing tails, perfect for cozy December evenings and simple, relaxing stitching. Hang it as holiday hoop art, add it to your seasonal gift corner, or stitch it onto linens for the season.
